reviews.t: Excellent contour kit at an affordable rate
reviews.x: This palette is at a very high end level even though it's so affordable.  As a professional makeup artist, I use contour on a regular basis on myself and my clients.  This one is excellent.  It has good undertones, blends beautifully and has lasting pigments.  If you haven't used contour before, their downloadable instructions are very helpful.  The company had a great response to a question as well so excellent communication.  What's not to love with this kit?

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the palette as a great, affordable value, especially for beginners or those new to contouring.
Several reviewers say the shades blend well and suit a range of skin tones, including fair and pale skin.
A common complaint is that the colors are too warm for a natural-looking contour.
Some reviewers report the powder applies unevenly or looks cakey, particularly on dry skin.
A few reviewers mention damaged pans on arrival, though others received theirs in perfect condition.
